quotes.text: All headers except for Bcc are expected to be included

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: EWS To/Cc recipients already exist in MIME content; Bcc is passed separately because its visible header is excluded. Current EWS CreateItem sends explicit bcc_recipients and DSN while SMTP appends Bcc to its envelope recipient list. Keep delivery recipients separate from visible message headers. Shared Graph Bcc/DSN regression knowledge52ebd8... was checked against current test_graph_bcc_dsn. That test does not by itself prove EWS Bcc wire output.
title: Carry Bcc separately without inserting it into transmitted MIME
